canon.note: Jiaoqiu (Fire, Nihility). Basic 121801 Heart Afire. Skill 121802 Scorch Onslaught: Fire Blast (80% primary + adjacent) with a 100% base chance to inflict 1 Ashen Roast. Ultimate 121804 Pyrograph Arcanum: AoE Fire, opens a Zone for 3 turns in which enemies take +Ult DMG and gain Ashen Roast on their turns (<=6 per Zone). Talent 121805 Ashen Roast: stacks increase DMG taken (first stack +2, each extra), also applies a Burn DoT of ATK per turn for 2 turns. A1 Pyre Cleanse +15 Energy at battle start. Energy 100.

fixtures.env: Jiaoqiu E0 solo vs 3 Fire-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7
Jiaoqiu E4 solo vs the same Elites - the Zone also drops enemy ATK 15% (jq_e4_atk)

requirements.claim: Skill Scorch Onslaught (121802) fires as a Skill action (decide nihility.ts:1530-1533 prefers Skill while SP >= 1).
Pyrograph Arcanum (121804) fires once Energy reaches 100 (energyMax nihility.ts:1516).
Scorch Onslaught is a Blast Skill: a primary Fire hit (nihility.ts:1565-1567).
Scorch Onslaught also hits adjacent enemies (nihility.ts:1567, 'Scorch Onslaught (adj)').
Basic Heart Afire lands a single Fire hit (nihility.ts:1577).
Pyrograph Arcanum is an AoE Fire Ultimate (nihility.ts:1547).
A1 Pyre Cleanse grants +15 Energy at battle start (nihility.ts:1519-1520), Jiaoqiu's first ENERGY_GAIN.
Talent 121805 Ashen Roast also applies a Burn DoT (ATK-scaled, 2 turns) whenever an Ashen Roast stack lands — the Burn DoT is talent-sourced (nihility.ts:1678-1686, only applyRoast emits it).
Skill (and Basic) inflict at least one Ashen Roast stack on the target (nihility.ts:1569, 1579).
The first Ashen Roast application starts at 1 stack (nihility.ts:1497).
Ashen Roast accompanies a Fire Burn DoT on the target (nihility.ts:1500-1507).
Ultimate's Zone marks enemies as taking +Ult DMG (nihility.ts:1552-1553, jq_zone_vuln).
Within a Skill, the damage resolves before the Ashen Roast lands (nihility.ts:1565 then 1569).
E4 Leisure In, Luster Out drops enemy ATK by 15% inside the Zone (nihility.ts:1555-1557, atkPct -0.15).
